name: visual-style-ppt
tagline_zh: 把文档变成风格统一的图片版PPT，先提炼视觉风格再生成，还能保存复用。别处没有：风格库管理，一次提取，永久调用。
tagline_en: Turn docs into image-only PPTs with a consistent style—extract, save, and reuse your visual library. Unique.
desc_en: Create style-driven slide images strictly with the Image 2 model, assemble those images into image-only PPTX decks, and manage reusable visual style libraries from documents or visual references. Use when the user asks for a "PPT Skill", "风格驱动 PPT", "提炼风格做 PPT", "调用某个风格做 PPT", "图片版 PPT", "保存 PPT 风格", "列出 PPT 风格", "文档生成 PPT", "文章生成 PPT", "把文档做成演示文稿", or wants to extract, save, reuse, and apply visu
why_zh: 同类工具直接出图，它先建风格库，再按库生成，保证每页视觉一致，且风格可复用，省去重复调参。
why_en: Unlike direct generators, it builds a reusable style library first, ensuring visual consistency across slides and saving you.
